invariants.description: filtered output matches the exact first-order step response
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(f_PNDMV_filt - (((f_min_PNDMV - f_max_PNDMV)/(1 + ((f_DMV + f_NActr + f_LCN)/f_mid_PNDMV)**k_PNDMV) + f_max_PNDMV)*(1 - np.exp(-t/tau_PNDMV))))) <= 1e-4 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(f_PNDMV_filt)))

invariants.description: f_PNDMV is the exact Gee 2023 sigmoid of its input
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(f_PNDMV - (((f_min_PNDMV - f_max_PNDMV)/(1 + ((f_DMV + f_NActr + f_LCN)/f_mid_PNDMV)**k_PNDMV) + f_max_PNDMV)))) <= 1e-9 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(f_PNDMV)))

bc_sweep.rationale: inputs over their source populations' output ranges; tau 0.3-10 s spans the Gee value (0.3) and ~7 s muscarinic response mentioned in Gee 2023; other constants x0.5-x2.

baseline.reason: intermediate neuronal population of the Gee 2023 reflex network: its firing rate is not measured on its own (parameters were identified from whole-system HR/elastance/ICN data), so there is no component-level data; checked against its exact static map. Validation belongs to the assembled closed-loop model (candidate: Gee 2023 Table 2 baseline SBP/DBP/HR/CO/EF and VNS % changes).
